latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video AI App — Edit and Export AI Videos.

- Instantly edit and export AI-generated video clips by uploading raw footage and describing your desired result.
- Automatic cloud setup: get connected and ready with a free, disposable session token (no registration required).
- Supports quick workflows for trimming silences, adding captions, and exporting in multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, etc.).
- Simple API actions mapped to user prompts for upload, credits check, export, and video editing.
- Handles error cases (token expiry, rate limits, unsupported files) with user-friendly guidance.
- No software to install; all rendering and processing are handled remotely on GPU nodes.
